script_text: Something in your orbit snaps into focus this week, Pisces. Monday into Tuesday, Venus in your 4th House trines Pluto in the 12th, so a family secret, lease, or conversation becomes clarifying. Tuesday is your best day because Jupiter in your 5th trines your ruler Neptune in the 2nd, making flirtation, art, or a money idea feel blessed. Wednesday is your worst day because Saturn stations retrograde in your 1st House, squaring Pluto, so sleep, boundaries, and your body ask for respect. Thursday, Mercury trines Saturn from your 4th, bringing paperwork, repairs, or a home-based career decision into place. Friday through Sunday, Mars in the 7th sextiles Neptune, so partnership talks soften and a client or lover offers a compromise. Saturday is best for contracts and money talks; Sunday favors rest. As a water sign ruled by Neptune, choose the quieter room. Follow for astrology updates.
